notes.title: FULL RELEASE
notes.notes:
We are glad to release The Last Man Survivor in full access today! 
What's in the game right now:


 3 maps with a plot and difficulty modifiers for them
 50 types of hand-drawn opponents
 9 unique characters
 Lots unique equipment and magic potions
 33 quest tasks

We hope you will have a lot of fun with our game!

Hotfix April 24

 Crit vampirism and passive regeneration no longer prevent you from completing the "Survive without restoring health" quest
 Fixed a bug with quest achievement with the release of 25 goblins
 Fixed a bug in displaying the maximum value of the passive regeneration meta boost
 Fixed minor visual bugs

notes.title: January'25 Minor Update
notes.notes:
Changed the price for rare items delivery, now it doesn't cost crystals but needs to be unlocked by achievement "Release 10/25 goblins from the cage"
 Lilith "endless game" bug fixed
 Game build size optimization
 Now you can see your bought and future meta progression
 Added loading wheel

notes.title: Winter'25 Update
notes.notes:
Today's update consists of modifiers. You may get new achievements by completing maps and getting curse points

Curse of the Elders
x3 Bosses. Experience gain is reduced by 2 times
Curse of the Horde
x2 enemy speed. x1.5 number of enemies (except Bosses)
Curse of the Warrior
No abilities, no potions. Only weapons
Curse of the Shadow
The hero is chased by shadows. Their touch instantly kills

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS RELEASE DATE: OCTOBER 24
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors!

We are finally ready to announce the exact date of release - 24th of October
What's coming? - New map and three new Survivors, different kinds of equipment, fresh potions and a lot of other stuff! Oh, yeah, almost forgot about the continuation of the story of the Last Survivor! Stay tuned!

notes.title: SPRING DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
Today we have updated the demo version of the game. What has changed:


 Added controller support
 Added new powerful enemies
 Added rings of thorns
 Improved visual style
 and many other small improvements

Please leave your feedback of the new demo version!

notes.title: Winter Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello folks! It has been a while since our last update of demo and we've prepared some new game mechanics for you.  We keep working on our game and want YOU to try it out. 
FIGHT. UPGRADE. SURVIVE!

Update

 Added equipment that increases Survivor's parameters
 Added shop and a new resource - gold
 Added a game object - the gold mine
 Added a new game object - the dungeon
 Added a healing potion
 The visual style of the game has been updated
 Optimized the loading of the game session
 Redesigned the interface of the "Fight" tab
